synth.notes:
Axis (wall band, block row A) + 3x3-block pieces + static targets; A5 cycles axis -> pieces by size desc (tie min block) -> axis; A1/A2 move axis/piece rows, A3/A4 piece cols, bounds 0..20, pieces block each other.
Missed mechanic at step 64: A5 order follows piece size/identity (L 7 blocks -> T 6 blocks -> axis), not current bbox rank; ablating to bbox order fails only step 64.
Piece blocks off the axis reflect to (2A-r,c) unless a piece is there; layered render piece>reflection>target(solid)>wall, holes transparent, selected holes 0.
Re-extraction: wall/player = 4-conn comps of own colour plus all 0 cells ranked by bbox (0-only comps count, explains wall_h_6 / piece_21); player gone = pieces merging; targets per sprite by visible bbox.
Passes 33/33 stateless too; unconfirmed: whether pieces may move onto the axis row (no observed collision).
